carousel.title: Stand Out
carousel.body: Want to get noticed in a remote job application? Learn the secrets to writing a winning app.

carousel.title: Lead with the Role
carousel.body: Open with the exact job title, where you saw it, and why your recent work fits what the team does.

carousel.title: Show Async Work
carousel.body: Remote teams want to know you can work independently. Mention a project you ran with written updates or a time zone gap you handled.

carousel.title: Match Their Words
carousel.body: Read the job post twice and use the same words. Hiring software and humans look for matching terms.
